finding.summary: TravelCenters of America Inc. (NASDAQ: TA) common stock listing ended as a completed cash-out merger: on May 15, 2023 a BP Products North America Inc. merger subsidiary merged into the Company; each share of Company common stock was converted into the right to receive $86.00 cash, shares ceased trading on Nasdaq prior to market open that day, and the Company requested Nasdaq file Form 25 to delist and later Form 15 to deregister. This is a fully completed delisting/acquisition, not merely an announcement; no successor ticker exists since holders received cash, not stock.
